how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-unknown-14.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:79242:title: No Honor Among Thieves
rows.quest:79242:details:0:
As I was saying...

Our boss wasn't with the ⟦E5⟧. She was a night elf named Illari Duskfeather. She gave us intel on the camps, and even let us keep most of the loot. She only kept a few of the rarer finds.

Once the Marshal was on our tail, though, she left us for dead. I don't know her motives, but I think we were set up as patsies.

I'm not the vengeful type, but I won't stop someone else from hunting her down. If you're looking for her, she once mentioned a hideout somewhere near Arathi.

rows.quest:92434:title: ⟦E11⟧ in the Streets
rows.quest:92434:obj:0: Find a way into ⟦E12⟧ along the Lordamere Lake.
rows.quest:92434:details:0: Whatever caused ⟦E12⟧'s barrier to lower has left the city in turmoil. With you having dealt with their patrols, there is no better time than now to make our way inside and discover their secrets.
rows.quest:92434:details:1: Take the key you found at the internment camp and seek out their sewers along the northern border of the city. With luck, those mages had no reason to put a ward over such a... disagreeable point of entry.
rows.quest:92434:progress:1: I think you will find that key won't be enough to get past my wards. You didn't truly think we would leave such a vulnerability open at a time like this, did you?
